facts.fact: CRAN confirmed dismissal of the reconsideration requests against its March 2026 refusal of Starlink's spectrum and telecommunications licences, and dismissed Starlink's own late reconsideration application; Starlink is not licensed in Namibia.

CRAN ordered Starlink to halt its satellite internet operations in Namibia for lack of a telecommunications licence, warned consumers against buying Starlink equipment and reported confiscating unauthorised terminals.
